# SourceShelf

> SourceShelf is a private AI knowledge base for Mac. Capture webpages, convert documents, organize sources into knowledge packs, and connect selected knowledge to compatible AI applications through local read-only workflows.

SourceShelf processes content locally on your Mac and keeps generated knowledge in portable formats such as Markdown, OKF bundles, AI reference packs, and llms.txt collections.

## Product

- [SourceShelf Home](https://sourceshelf.app/)
  Learn about the private AI knowledge base for Mac.

  Download SourceShelf for macOS.

## Key Concepts

SourceShelf concepts:

- Local-first document conversion
- Safari webpage capture
- Markdown knowledge management
- AI reference packs
- Retrieval-ready context
- Open Knowledge Format (OKF)
- llms.txt collections
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Read-only AI knowledge access

## Product Principles

SourceShelf follows these principles:

- User-owned files.
- Local processing.
- Portable formats.
- Explicit AI permissions.
- No hidden cloud processing.
